faults.fault: At 2x width the grille is stretched into smeared dark blobs instead of gaining a second grille; at 1.5x height it is stretched into a long banded smear with chevron repeats down the whole upper band. A counted item was stretched instead of repeated.

At 2x width the front/background panel shows repeated smeared vent ovals and streaked bands across the lower body, and the ARCADE marquee band shows vertical streaking — classic tiling smear on the widened panel.
At 1.5x height the extra height went into a stretched, smeared upper section instead of a longer plain lower body/kick panel below the control deck, which is what a taller cabinet means.

wider_means: A wider arcade cabinet is a two-player cabinet: a second joystick and button set added on the control deck, with a wider body, screen bezel and speaker band carrying them.
taller_means: A taller arcade cabinet has a longer plain lower body and kick panel below the control deck -- more bare carcass, not a taller screen or marquee.

faults.fault: At 2x width the lower panel shows mirrored/duplicated vent motifs and vertical streak bands where the panel was stretched, and the marquee 'ARCADE' text is smeared wide instead of the panel tiling cleanly. At 1.5x height the side 'SPACE WARP' decal reads 'WARP' mirrored/doubled mid-panel. A player could point at all of these as broken tiling.

At 2x width the control deck stretched into one long smeared deck with seam artefacts instead of gaining a second joystick/button cluster -- a wider arcade cabinet is a two-player cabinet, and this one just got wider with the same single set of controls.

At 2x width the screen glass itself stretched into one wide cinematic pane instead of the bezel extending around a same-size centre screen; the spanx_center rule (middle stays one size, ends extend) was not honoured.

At 2x wider the screen is stretched to the full cabinet width with smeared bezel edges instead of staying one centered screen with the ends extending. Blocking.
At 2x wider the deck is stretched, not repeated: same two joysticks pulled apart with smeared button graphics between them, rather than additional button clusters per bay. Blocking.
At 2x wider the speaker band shows jagged smeared dark shapes instead of per-bay round grilles; the extra bays carry stretched texture, not clean repeated grilles. Blocking.
